note: Daily scan 27 Nov: deaths in an Iranian strike on a Kuwaiti vital facility, Houthi hit on Jazan refinery, ADNOC crew death confirmed.

signals.source: Gulf News / Khaleej Times / TradeArabia: UAE business and utilities
signals.summary: Kuwait said an Iranian drone attack on a 'vital facility' killed two Italian nationals and caused damage. The Houthis hit a Jazan refinery in Saudi Arabia. ADNOC L&S confirmed the crew member missing since the 17 Nov attack was found dead. Israel said it is ready to strike Iran without US support. No attacks on UAE territory.
signals.check: Strikes on GCC critical facilities are now causing deaths among contractors and staff. Confirm shelter-in-place and evacuation drills at control centres, major substations and sites with contractor crews.
signals.notes: Opened Gulf News evening briefing (26 Nov, grade C) citing Kuwait's Ministry of Defence, the Saudi coalition and ADNOC L&S. Updates SQ-0099 (now one fatality). Another tanker was hit 33 km east of Khasab on 25 Nov (UKMTO). Relevant to ER-02.
